people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
translations.bsb: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites set out, transporting it.
translations.kjv: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
translations.asv: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bare the tabernacle, set forward.
